scope: Proposition 10.2 (Amplification) of the manuscript “A two-dimensional area law from a global spectral gap” (preprints/A-two-dimensional-area-law-from-a-global-spectral-gap-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 265 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 91e272a2245ad0bd), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 74. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix C0 > 0 and let ε, β, α be as in (10.1). Suppose n ≥ 2, L = ⌊n1−ε⌋, and X = A ∩ T, S0 = A ∩ TL, Y = S0 \ X, Z′ = Λ \ S0. Assume that |S0| ≤ C0n2, that each of the three cuts X, Y, S0 has at most C0n crossing edges, and that I := IΩ(X : Z′ ) ≤ C0n1−ε . (10.15) For every integer M ≥ 1, at all sufficiently large n, there is an integer radius r such that r ≤ CM n(1−ε)/α , L + 2r = o(nβ ), (10.16) and, simultaneously for every physical set J ⊆ Λ \ N2r(S0), IΩ(X : J) ≤ CM n−M . (10.17) The same bound holds with any subset of X in place of X. The constants and the threshold may depend on C0 and M, but are independent of Λ, A, T subject to the stated assumptions. If in addition dist∞(T, Z) > L + nβ , (10.18) where Z is the set of endpoints of the original cut, then N2r(S0) ⊆ A. In particular the remote set J may include all of Λ \ A.
